title: Code timeline versus learned-state timeline
summary: Semantic Source Control and ML Journal state are separate timelines. A model generation may identify both its source revision and its journal point; rewinding one must never silently imply rewinding the other.
authority: Executable source/tests and supplied upstream API artifacts are authoritative; this sphere preserves architecture and continuity.
invariants: Stable source entity identity is distinct from source revision.
Learned-state rollback does not automatically change executing code.
Generation provenance should record source lineage/revision when material to reproducibility.
procedure: When a live code repair changes behavior, preserve both the source revision and the pre-repair learned checkpoint for comparison.

provenance.claim: Stable source entities and revision IDs.
